description: Source code for the Messenger plugin in WPEFramework, implementing room management, messaging, and plugin lifecycle methods.

classes.name: Messenger
classes.description: Implements messaging and room management functionalities within the plugin.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Messenger plugin, setting up room admin and service references.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and releases references.

methods.name: JoinRoom
methods.description: Joins a specified room with a user, creating a notification sink.

methods.name: SubscribeUserUpdate
methods.description: Subscribes or unsubscribes to user updates in a room.

methods.name: LeaveRoom
methods.description: Leaves a specified room and releases associated resources.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified room.

methods.name: GenerateRoomId
methods.description: Generates a unique room ID based on room name, user name, and current time.
